title: Northgate Store and Online Orders — Fulfilment, Pickup Holds and Cancellation
content:
**Pickup holds.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, an Order Pickup or Drive Up order is held for the program's hold days, counted in calendar days after its ready date. Collected within that time, it becomes fulfilled on the collection date; not collected, it is canceled on the day after the last hold day and every line and fee is refunded with reason unclaimed pickup. An unclaimed order is refunded under the program's unclaimed refund, and photo ID is checked at pickup where the program requires it.

**Cancellation.**
- Cancelling an order is the customer's own decision, recorded as a cancellation request and confirmed by the customer.
- An order can be canceled only while it is in placed status. This is read from the order's status in the system record for this order, not from the customer's account of it. The statuses open to cancellation are those listed for the program.
- A canceled order refunds every line and fee with reason order canceled, except the late cancellation fee of a large-item order under the order fee rules.

| Order status shown on the record | Customer may cancel |
|---|---|
| placed | yes |
| ready, fulfilled, canceled or returned | no |

**Large-item reschedules.** The clause *"A large-item delivery may be rescheduled before the cutoff, the first of the program's free reschedules carrying no fee."* is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for reschedules of a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment.

**Missing or damaged items.** An item reported missing, or damaged on arrival, within the program's report days of the fulfilled date is refunded without a return with reason item not received or item damaged with no return; a report after that is handled as an ordinary return under the returns rule.

**Fulfilment fee.** The clause *"The fulfilment fee is refunded with reason fee refund only when the whole order was not received or under the returns rule."* is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for fulfilment fee refunds.

**Returned status.** When every unit of every line has been returned or refunded, the order becomes returned.

**Hypothetical hold.** With 5 hold days and a ready date of 10 June, the order may be collected through 15 June; uncollected, it is canceled on 16 June.
